questions.topic: Gerund and infinitive after a verb
questions.learningObjective: Explain infinitive use after a verb of desire
questions.stem: Why do we say 'Quiero entrenar' rather than 'Quiero entrenando'?

answer.exemplar: Verbs of desire like querer take an infinitive for the action desired, while the gerund would describe a simultaneous circumstance.
